title: Spacing and Layout
summary: Spacing expresses relationships and creates scan rhythm through a documented scale.

MUST.text: Use a documented spacing scale; separate groups more than items within a group.
Use a 4px base scale: 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96 (px) (or rem equivalents); never one-off gaps.
Keep within-group gap smaller than between-group gap (e.g., 8-12px inside, 24-32px between).

SHOULD.text: Adapt page gutters and columns to content and viewport (e.g., 16px mobile, 24px tablet, 32px desktop).
Cap content measure around 1200-1280px; use fluid widths below.
Preserve grouping and avoid clipping at narrow widths and 200% zoom (WCAG 1.4.10).

AVOID.text: Do not invent one-off gaps for every component.
Horizontal scroll for primary content at 320px width.

EXAMPLE.good: "Label 4px from input; 24px to next field group."
EXAMPLE.bad: "Every element separated by 16px regardless of relationship."

FAILURE_MODES: Equal spacing hides grouping and increases scan time.
One-off gaps break consistency and theming.
Fixed gutters cause clipping on narrow screens.
Reflow can collapse groups; re-check at 320px.
